2608.11847.title: LookBack: Where and How to Score LVLM Responses via Visual Reference Usage
2608.11847.paper_summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) integrate visual perception with language generation, enabling responses that span image understanding and complex reasoning. However, LVLMs do not just inherit the text-level hallucinations; they also hallucinate against the image, producing fluent responses ungrounded in what they see. This makes LVLM response scoring inherently harder, and our diagnostics show that existing confidence-based metrics adopted from LLMs are insufficient for LVLMs. Specifically, removing the input image barely changes confidence-based selection, suggesting that output-space confidence primarily captures textual plausibility rather than agreement with the image. To address this gap, we propose LookBack, a training-free LVLM response scoring method that augments token likelihood with visual lookback score, a lightweight measure of how strongly each response token refers to image tokens. Across four benchmarks and three models, LookBack consistently improves Best-of-$N$ selection over existing baselines with negligible additional overhead.
2608.11847.paper_summary_zh: 大型視覺語言模型（LVLMs）將視覺感知與語言生成整合在一起，使得回應能夠涵蓋圖像理解和複雜推理。<lb/>然而，LVLMs 不僅僅繼承了文本層級的幻覺；它們還會對圖像產生幻覺，生成流暢的回應卻與它們所見的內容無關。<lb/>這使得 LVLM 的回應評分本質上變得更加困難，我們的診斷顯示，從 LLMs 採用的現有基於信心的指標對於 LVLMs 是不夠的。<lb/>具體來說，移除輸入圖像幾乎不改變基於信心的選擇，這表明輸出空間的信心主要捕捉文本的合理性，而不是與圖像的一致性。<lb/>為了解決這一差距，我們提出了 LookBack，一種無需訓練的 LVLM 回應評分方法，該方法通過視覺回顧分數增強標記的可能性，這是一種輕量級的衡量指標，用於評估每個回應標記與圖像標記的相關程度。<lb/>在四個基準測試和三個模型中，LookBack 一直在現有基準上穩定地改善最佳 $N$ 選擇，且額外開銷微乎其微。
